user.title: Connect to the matrix
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant talks to the gofanco Matrix44-HDBT.

menu_options.tcp: Network (built-in network module or a serial-to-TCP adapter)
menu_options.serial: Serial port (RS-232 / USB adapter on this Home Assistant host)

tcp.title: Network connection
tcp.description: The matrix's network module listens on TCP port 23 and accepts the same commands as RS-232. Give it a DHCP reservation in your router so the address doesn't change.

serial.title: Serial connection
serial.description: Connect the matrix's RS-232 port (3-pin Phoenix, use the included DB9 cable). The matrix default is 9600 baud, 8N1.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Switch between network and serial, or change the address or port. Entities and their history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the connection. Check the address/port or the serial device.

abort.already_configured: This matrix connection is already configured.

init.title: Matrix options
init.description: Name the inputs and outputs (blank keeps the default). Names are used for entity names and the source lists.

data.auto_power_on: Turn the matrix on automatically when routing

data_description.poll_interval: The matrix pushes changes as they happen; the poll is a safety net.
data_description.auto_power_on: In standby the matrix ignores every command except power on.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send any RS-232 command (a trailing '.' is added) and return the matrix's reply lines.

command.name: Command
command.description: For example STA., PresetSta01. or EDIDGOUT04.
